attempts.text:
**The window opens on a short spine.** Columns 0 to 2, `gmk` to `yicG`, are carried by 92 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 2% of calls. The model names 93 to 99.8% of them, fewest at column 1, `ligB`, 93%.

**A variable column follows**, column 3, `dinD`, carried by 78%. A second branch of 5 families runs through columns 19 to 23, a parallel path carried instead of the most carried families there, in 19% of chromosomes.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 90 against 82%, and hesitates less there, 0.28 against 0.32 bits. Its most hesitant column, 52, `yibG`, is a variable column, at 1.00 bits.

**The window ends in fork columns.** Columns 56 to 79 are carried by 1 to 88% of chromosomes, 15 shell and 9 persistent. The last column is `xylG`, in 43% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 87% of genes**, 0.30 bits on average, perplexity 1.7 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.59 against 0.17 bits, and names fewer genes, 73% against 93%.

label: gmk
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the gmk window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor gmk, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 60 to 139 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying gmk once); 43,198 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 87% of genes, 0.30 bits on average (perplexity 1.7 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 28,511 calls, named 96%, 0.12 bits; shell 14,099 calls, named 72%, 0.53 bits; cloud 588 calls, named 22%, 3.32 bits. Outside an RGP 30,186 calls, named 93%, 0.17 bits; inside an RGP 13,012 calls, named 73%, 0.59 bits. Columns: 45 spine, 19 fork, 16 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.59 against 0.17 bits) and names fewer genes (73% against 93%); 13,012 of the 43,198 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 52 (yibG, a variable column) 1.00 bits, RGP 17%; column 4 (yicC, a spine column) 0.82 bits, RGP 15%; column 53 (yibF, a spine column) 0.76 bits, RGP 17%. The 22 columns (columns 19-24 and 57-72) where most calls are in an RGP: named 79%, 0.31 bits on average; the other 58 columns: named 90%, 0.29 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 45 spine columns: named 90%, 0.28 bits on average; the 35 fork and variable columns: named 82%, 0.32 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 52, is a variable column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 19-24 (fork), RGP 63-93%; the least: columns 0-2 (spine), RGP 0-2%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-2 (3 columns) spine: share 92-100%, all P, RGP 0-2%. Genes: gmk, ligB, yicG "trimeric intracellular cation chann…". named 93-99.8% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 1 (ligB), named 93%, 0.47 bits.
[S2] 2. column 3 variable: share 78%, all S, RGP 15%. named 81%; 0.62 bits.
[S2.c3]    3: dinD S 78%
[S3] 3. columns 4-15 (12 columns) spine: share 97-99%, all P, RGP 13-16%. Genes: yicC "YicC/YloC family endoribonuclease", rph, pyrE, slmA, dut, coaBC, radC, rpmB "50S ribosomal protein L28", rpmG, mutM, coaD, waaA. named 81-92% (mean 90%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 4 (yicC), named 81%, 0.82 bits.
[S4] 4. column 16 fork: share 76%, all S, RGP 13%. named 80%; 0.33 bits.
[S4.c16]    16: rfaQ S 76%; also rfaQ (another family) S 21%
[S5] 5. columns 17-18 (2 columns) spine: share 98%, all P, RGP 13-30%. Genes: waaG, rfaP. named 90-92% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 18 (rfaP), named 90%, 0.41 bits.
[S6] 6. columns 19-24 (6 columns) fork: share 36-55%, all S, RGP 63-93%. named 55-64% (mean 58%), fewest named at column 21, named 55%; most hesitant at column 19, 0.64 bits.
[S6.b19]    a second branch of 5 families through columns 19-23, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 19%, all S; the branch's families: waaO, rfaY, waaR, waaD, rfaL

[S7] 7. columns 25-42 (18 columns) spine: share 95-99%, all P, RGP 3-32%.
